Contract ManageUserCRUDService::createUser(userid: Integer,name: String,address: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		existingUser: User = User.allInstance()->any(o: User|o.UserID = userid),
		userExists: Boolean = if existingUser.oclIsUndefined() = false 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif ,
		success: Boolean = true
	precondition:
		userid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		name.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		address.oclIsTypeOf(String)
	postcondition:
		if userExists = true 
		then result = success 
		else let newUser: User in
		newUser.oclIsNew() and
		User.allInstance()->includes(newUser) and
		newUser.UserID = userid and
		newUser.Name = name and
		newUser.Address = address and
		result = success 
		endif 
}
